jobs.title: Security testing (b-Aware)
jobs.pay: Critical 10 BSV · High 3 BSV · Medium 0.5 BSV · Low: credit
jobs.pay_note: Paid from a 20 BSV pool each quarter.
jobs.what: Read the code and try the apps. Find a way to take funds, read keys, or get past an approval in bWalletX, bWallet or bChatX.
rules: Test only your own wallets and accounts. No real users' funds or data.
First valid report of an issue is paid. Duplicates earn credit.
Rewards are paid after the fix ships.
Keep it private until it is fixed. Full policy and safe harbour on b-Aware.
Anyone can report by email. To receive a reward you sign in with bWalletX on this page and verify your identity with Veriff.
jobs.submit_text: Email support@bwalletx.com with the subject b-Aware. Not the form below.
jobs.link_text: Read the b-Aware policy and rates

jobs.title: Paid Android testing
jobs.pay_note: 0.25 BSV after the first open from Google Play, 0.75 BSV after 12 of 14 daily check-ins.
jobs.what: Install bWallet from the Google Play test and use it every day for 14 days: send a little, receive, try the features, and tell us what breaks.
rules: Apply with Google on /testers first. Testers are approved by hand.
Use the Google account on your Android phone.
One tester per person. The app checks in once a day when you open it.
Sign in with bWalletX below to send test reports and notes.
